# Coddy.Tech

> > Coddy.Tech is a free, gamified interactive coding platform that makes learning to code engaging through streaks, leaderboards, and certificates across 15+ programming languages.

Coddy.Tech provides an accessible entry point for aspiring developers with a mobile-friendly interface, real-time progress tracking, and community-driven learning features. The platform supports multiple programming languages including Python, JavaScript, Java, C++, SQL, and more, making it suitable for beginners and intermediate learners.

## Key Topics

- Python
- JavaScript
- Java
- C++
- SQL
- HTML
- CSS
- Free Coding Platform
- Interactive Learning
- Gamification
- Coding Streaks
- Leaderboards
- Certificates
- Mobile App
- Multi-Language Support

## Getting Started

- [Learn to Code for Free with Coddy.Tech - Code Makes Perfect](https://coddy.tech): Coddy.Tech homepage: free interactive coding platform with gamification, streaks, and certificates.
